description:
Create a lever in a zone of the audit map, or update one by its id (an
argument you omit keeps its value). Cite the returned id as <LEVER:id> in
the zone document. Its class is computed from effort × gain_delay ×
timing; the follow-up (status, assignee, note) is set on its page.

deadline.description: The deadline in words, when timing is before
deadline.title: Deadline

deadline_at.description: The deadline's date as YYYY-MM-DD, when timing is before
deadline_at.title: Deadline At

deliverable.description: What the team gets in hand
deliverable.title: Deliverable

effort.description: days, weeks or months of work to land it
effort.title: Effort

estimate.description: The lever's gain: {"value": "≈ 1,1 M€" (display text), "label": "de marge par an si ..." (what the amount is), "rows": [{"label", "text", "query": query id}], "calc": "how the rows combine", "takeaway": "one sentence"}
estimate.title: Estimate

gain_delay.description: immediate (weeks), short (quarter), medium (year), long_term (beyond a year) or none
gain_delay.title: Gain Delay

lever.description: The lever to update, as <LEVER:id> or its uuid; omit to create one
lever.title: Lever

name.description: A short imperative title ("Réallouer le stock des 22 magasins en rupture")
name.title: Name

needs.description: What it needs before it can start
needs.title: Needs

next.description: The very next step, one sentence
next.title: Next

owner.description: The team that would carry it ("Supply")
owner.title: Owner

risks.description: What could make it fail or backfire
risks.title: Risks

stage.description: ready, extract, test, decide, build, explore, blocked or abandoned
stage.title: Stage

steps.description: The steps to land it, in order
steps.title: Steps

success.description: How the team will know it worked
success.title: Success

timing.description: now, before (a deadline), wait (for something) or any; any but before clears the deadline
timing.title: Timing

type.description: decision (a choice to make), list (a list to act on) or rule (a rule to automate)
type.title: Type

zone.description: The zone's slug, from its document's ```zone block
zone.title: Zone

name: myriade_audit_record_lever
